description: This file defines the DataPopulator interface, a generic utility for populating or converting data from a source to a target object within the context of a MerchantStore and Language, possibly involving data conversion exceptions.

classes.name: DataPopulator
classes.description: A generic interface for populating data from a source object to a target object, with methods that can throw ConversionException, considering merchant store and language context.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates an existing target object with data from the source object, considering merchant store and language, may throw ConversionException.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Creates and returns a new populated target object based on the source, merchant store, and language, may throw ConversionException.
